name: veracross-plus
description: Enhanced Veracross portal experience with homework checklists, grade estimation, and navigation improvements

scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: npm run clean:chrome && npm run copy:chrome && npm run package:chrome
scripts.build:firefox: npm run clean:firefox && npm run copy:firefox && npm run package:firefox
scripts.clean: npm run clean:chrome && npm run clean:firefox
scripts.copy:chrome: mkdir -p dist/chrome && cp manifest-chrome.json dist/chrome/manifest.json && cp *.js *.css *.html dist/chrome/
scripts.copy:firefox: mkdir -p dist/firefox && cp manifest-firefox.json dist/firefox/manifest.json && cp *.js *.css *.html dist/firefox/
scripts.watch: npm run dev:chrome && npm run dev:firefox
scripts.validate: npm run validate:chrome && npm run validate:firefox
scripts.validate:chrome: echo 'Chrome extension validation would go here'
scripts.validate:firefox: echo 'Firefox extension validation would go here'

author: Veracross Plus Team
